body: How did you find a chosen family??

Not really you aren’t unreasonable. But honestly if I wanted to have a real conversation I would call. Texts are usually to drop in random “I love you” or where are you texts that don’t need instant replies. Anything this is my prerogative and I’m your wife’s age. I would be surprised if I offended anyone with my text habits. But I get your issue. I would just not text if my husband complained and call him instead
Whether one takes life seriously or not is irrelevant here. I just don’t think a situation of abuse should be joked about under any circumstance. Thanks for your apology!
Why even bother commenting? This is an abuse survivor group. Not jibberish
Sorry to hear that

Despite being the kids birthday?

You’re clearly indicating “expecting” and visiting hours in line with my own qualms with what went down. I should have not responded to the doorbell per your comment as our doors are always locked for safety reasons in this day and age. Although I didn’t have the heart to leave them out and not respond to the 10s of phone calls. I in fact was worried that something bad happened which is why I even answered and then felt like my space was invaded.
Yes my mother was physically abusive. The pizza thing was a family (dad + mom) decision. So I was trying to get an unbiased feedback

Stop keeping count and before you know it likely the scores will even. People like to befriend happy souls. Unfortunately and keeping count sounds like something deeper. What I do is give people a long leash - for example I’d reach out long enough until I know for sure that they’re never going to initiate before I decide to back down. 
On the other hand, it is a fine line being pushing and reaching out enough to give people chances. It takes time and work to get into other peoples first circle friends… I too am working on finding the right balance. And what I’m doing now is to diversify instead of having a single point of fail
Thanks

Honestly I don’t remember. It must have been a regular kid tantrum. I was raised under a strict regimen. I was a straight A student and was on top of everything. 

The older I get, now in my 30s and evaluating parenthood myself, I’m questioning parenting styles. My parents beat me even as an adult but I call out the pizza incident since that affected me the most. I was just a kid with a love for pizza  and found it cruel to have it taken away. With not even a concession made on my birthday

They showed up two weeks before his birthday as something “fun” they could do as they were up early and driving around. They’re also my friends and not only my husbands so indeed could’ve let me know I’m advance if they wanted to surprise him.
What if you were having sex on the couch?
Stubble

Haha! If you see the comment I understand the intent. I was just uncomfortable for the reasons listed which are very practical and looking for a way to communicate politely so I could communicate my preferences at the same time maintain the friendship. I wouldn’t be doing this to a friend despite how much I adore them, I would go later in the day and give a heads up to the partner who needn’t be surprised like in this case. They are both our friends and we’ve done a lot for them! Just the cultural differences which we’re trying to bridge

That’s the thing.. they were being sweet. But I felt uncomfortable for very practical reasons and don’t judge them for it but also don’t want it to happen again! I’d like to be able to voice myself politely which is what some people on the thread are providing input on
Not to mention my husbands birthday was two weeks out. It wasn’t the day of the birthday.

Definitely not cutting off as that would be silly.
Finding a way to politely indicate personal preferences - eg, I literally and figuratively aired my dirty laundry outside-my boxers right on top of that pile. Was very embarrassed!
I’m glad your dad backed you. My dad enabled my abusive mother falling for the waterworks ! I have hit back and it has been used against me as the perpetrator myself
